財務回顧                                       FINANCIAL REVIEW

營業額                                        Revenue

式，着眼長期主義，以核心能力的確定性應對           remained adhering to its strategy of “dual-drive” of residential properties

管理之中。                          In addition, we also grasped the opportunities arising from green and

                               our businesses.

風險管理程序                        Risk Management Process

除董事會的監管責任外，本公司亦設計出風險          In addition to the Board’s oversight responsibilities, the Company has
管理程序，以識別、評估及管理重大風險，並          developed a risk management process to identify, evaluate and manage
解決重大內部監控缺陷（如有）。高級管理層透         significant risks and to resolve material internal control defects (if any).
過本公司的內部審核部門負責年度風險呈報程          Senior management, through the Company’s internal audit department, is
序。內部審核部門的成員與高級管理層若干成          responsible for the annual risk reporting process. Members of the internal
員會面，審視及評估風險，並探討重大內部監          audit department meet with various members of the senior management
控缺陷（如有）的解決方案，包括有關年度適用         to review and assess risks and discuss solutions to address material
的任何變動，對風險進行匯總、評級並記錄緩          internal control defects (if any), including any changes relevant to a given
解計劃。風險評估乃由高級管理層若干成員進          year. Risks are compiled, ratings are assigned and mitigation plans are
行回顧，提呈審核委員會及董事會以供審閱。          documented. The risk assessment is reviewed by certain members of
                              senior management and presented to the Audit Committee and the
                              Board for their review.

險影響的嚴重程度、(ii)風險發生的概率及(iii)風   the severity of the impact of the risk on the Company’s financial results,
險可能發生的速率或速度評估風險。              (ii) the probability that the risk will occur, and (iii) the velocity or speed at

    2.23 撥備及或然負債                        2.23 Provisions and contingent liabilities

        倘本集團因過往事件而現時須承擔法                   Provisions are recognised when: the Group has a present legal
        定或推定責任，且履行該等責任可能                   or constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is more
        須流出資源，及所涉及的金額能可靠                   likely than not that an outflow of resources will be required to
        估計時，則確認撥備。未來營運虧損                   settle the obligation; and the amount has been reliably estimated.
        毋須確認撥備。                            Provisions are not recognised for future operating losses.

        倘存在多項相若責任時，履行該等責                   Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood
        任是否需要流出資源在考慮整體責任                   that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by
        之類別後釐定。即使同一類別之任何                   considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is
        一項責任可能須資源流出的可能性極                   recognised even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to
        低，亦須確認撥備。                          any one item included in the same class of obligations may be
                                           small.

        撥備按管理層對於報告期末對須償付                   Provisions are measured at the present value of management’s
        現有責任的最佳估計支出的現值計                    best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the present
        量。用於釐定現值的貼現率為反映當                   obligation at the end of the reporting period. The discount rate
        時市場對金錢時間值及負債特定風險                   used to determine the present value is a pre-tax rate that reflects
        的評估的稅前利率。隨時間增加的撥                   current market assessments of the time value of money and the
        備確認為利息開支。                          risks specific to the liability. The increase in the provision due to
                                           the passage of time is recognised as interest expense.

        或然負債乃一項因過往事件可能產生                   A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from
        的責任，而該責任的存在僅可由一項                   past events and whose existence will only be confirmed by
        或多項並非由本集團全權控制之日後                   the occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more uncertain
        不明朗事件之存在與否確定。或然負                   future events not wholly within the control of the Group. It can
        債亦可為因不大可能需要經濟資源流                   also be a present obligation arising from past events that is not
        出或承擔之金額未能可靠地估量而未                   recognised because it is not probable that outflow of economic
        確認之過往事件產生之現有承擔。                    resources will be required or the amount of obligation cannot be

        現變動致使有可能流出，則將其確認                   change in the probability of an outflow occurs so that outflow is
        為撥備。                               probable, it will then be recognised as a provision.

        該物業將根據本集團最近開發計劃開                        approach has taken into account the construction costs incurred
